interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The eleven measures
interactives.text: Eleven stones, eleven lengths. A shard tuned against all of them is a shard the Barrens factor will sign for.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The gallery's under-room. Books read three times as fast in the quiet.

interactives.label: The ringing stone
interactives.text: The quarry face rings when it is struck and the blank rang clean. Foreman Hesk hung a bell to test it; he does not trust the note.

interactives.label: Lenses
interactives.text: A lens ground here is checked against the mirror basins before it leaves the city.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The citadel
interactives.text: The citadel was the first lens: a city built to look at one thing.

interactives.label: The quarry
interactives.text: The ringing face is not marble. The blank drawn out of it rang because it was hollow.

interactives.label: The bowl
interactives.text: The range is a bowl with no way out but the cols on its northern rim; the roads that leave, leave by them.

interactives.label: The Citadel Reliquary
interactives.text: The shrine's own relic room, opened with a reed the basins grew.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Crossings
interactives.text: Every crossing to a neighbouring region has a waygate two tiles inside it, so you see the border before you step over it.

sections.name: The Reed Cut
sections.label: A hide of cut reeds, and a plank floor under it where there should be mud.
sections.note: A cut in the lake bank where the reed grows out of the wind and the clay is clean.

sections.name: The Lens-Grinders' Garden
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: Sand and salt the grinders keep to themselves, in beds under the works.

sections.name: The Canal Cache
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: A dry sluice chamber with a chest, a bench and the clay the potters dig from it.

sections.name: The Orrery Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the orrery, the keepers' strongroom: the same work counts double here.

sections.name: The East Stair Pit
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: A quarry pit the stair cut through, where the watch trains against penned elk.

sections.name: The Rose Gallery School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the lens-masters teach the apprentices to read a chart before they grind.

sections.name: The Basin Spring
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: The warm feed of the mirror basins, in a chamber the masons left open.

sections.name: The South Watch Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: The watch's gallery: straw butts and slow stags at the far end.

sections.name: The Citadel Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: The shrine's own relic room, opened with a reed the basins grew.

sections.name: The Cistern Well
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: The old cistern: its stones swallow every word of a spell.

sections.name: The Lens Focus
sections.label: A seam of crystal that hums at a touch; the rock behind it is thin.
sections.note: Where the west lens tower gathers its light the ether comes cheap.

sections.name: The Quarry Adit
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: The quarrymen's adit under the rim, out onto the range.

sections.name: The Mirror Waystone
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Five stones under the plaza flags. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Overlook Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A pocket in the overlook cliff with a cistern and a view.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Mirrorhold Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
